## About
Alta Mere Dallas is a window tint and auto accessory shop on Lemmon Ave. We help you pick the right product for your car or truck, install it, and show you how to use it.
Window tint is the heart of what we do, along with paint protection, radar detection, Bluetooth, car audio, security and a long list of accessories. Whether you want a small touch or a complete makeover, we can help you choose.
We try to treat every customer the way we would want to be treated, and our management team follows up with you after the work is done.

## Services
- Window tint: Tint in a range of grades and shades, chosen to fit your needs and match your car.
- Paint protection: An added layer over your paint to guard against dings, scuffs, scratches, sand and dust. You choose the level of coverage.
- Radar detectors: Top of the line radar detectors, installed by our team.
- Dash cameras: Dash cam installs for your car or truck.
- Security and Bluetooth: Auto security and Bluetooth connectivity installed and set up for you.
- Remote start: Remote start installed on your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: Can you tint the front windshield?
A: Yes. Along with full car tint, we list front windshield tint among our tint options.

Q: Do you work on trucks too?
A: Yes. We help you choose, install and use what you need on your car or truck.

Q: Will anyone check in after my install?
A: Yes. Our management team follows up with you after the work is completed.
